forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.
forgot.email_disabled: This installation can't send email yet. Please ask an administrator to reset your password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
reset.missing_token: This link is incomplete. Please use the full link from the email, or ask for a new one.

change_password.title: Change password
change_password.forced_notice: Welcome! Please choose your own password to continue.
